meta.title: Jujutsu Shenanigans achievements data
meta.imagePolicy: Achievement rows use null images by default. The source exposes a generic achievement icon, not clean row-specific achievement images.

sources.label: Jujutsu Shenanigans Wiki - Update Log/V1.70 to V1.61

excludedSourceRows.name: Nep
excludedSourceRows.reason: Excluded from the public achievement dataset because the approved scope excludes codes/events. The source-listed row is code-gated, and the exact code string should stay out of this catalog.

excludedSourceRows.name: Daily quest pool
excludedSourceRows.reason: Excluded because daily quests rotate and pay Cash rather than behaving like permanent achievement rows.

excludedSourceRows.name: Weekly quest pool
excludedSourceRows.reason: Excluded because weekly quests rotate and pay Cash rather than behaving like permanent achievement rows.

excludedSourceRows.name: Empty character categories
excludedSourceRows.reason: The current Achievements source lists these character categories as None, so they do not create card rows.

items.name: Grade 4
items.requirement: Obtain 50 kills.
items.notes: First kill-count grade in the achievement list.

items.name: Grade 3
items.requirement: Obtain 200 kills.
items.notes: A low-mid kill milestone for normal play.

items.name: Semi Grade 2
items.requirement: Obtain 500 kills.
items.notes: A longer account-kill milestone.

items.name: Grade 2
items.requirement: Obtain 1,000 kills.
items.notes: The first four-digit kill milestone.

items.name: Semi Grade 1
items.requirement: Obtain 2,500 kills.
items.notes: A high account-kill milestone.

items.name: Grade 1
items.requirement: Obtain 5,000 kills.
items.notes: A major account-kill milestone.

items.name: Special Grade
items.requirement: Obtain 10,000 kills.
items.notes: Highest listed kill-count grade in the current source.

items.name: Your own story!
items.requirement: Create a custom server.
items.notes: Counts the act of creating a custom server, not a platform server listing.

items.name: Popular
items.requirement: Have 20 different players join your custom server.
items.notes: Requires other players to join the custom server.

items.name: Prepare to lose 3 stocks
items.requirement: Win a duel match without losing a single life.
items.notes: Requires a clean duel result with no lost life.

items.name: Poor Performance
items.requirement: Earn a total of $0 in Roulette.
items.notes: A mode-specific achievement tied to ending with no Roulette payout.

items.name: The strongest of history
items.requirement: Win as Strongest Of History in Final Showdown.
items.notes: Only source-backed permanent achievement reward found; local cosmetics links Phenomenal to this achievement.
items.sourcePage: Jujutsu Shenanigans Wiki - Achievements and Victory Flashes
items.verificationNote: Achievements trivia and Victory Flashes trivia both identify Phenomenal as the reward.

items.name: Addict
items.requirement: Drink 20 sodas in one life.
items.notes: Requires repeated Soda use without dying.

items.name: It's Over.
items.requirement: Kill a Restless Gambler while they are in Jackpot state.
items.notes: Requires the target to be in Jackpot when killed.

items.name: The one who left it all behind
items.requirement: Kill the caster of a domain expansion.
items.notes: A domain-related kill achievement.

items.name: Public Service Assassin
items.requirement: Kill the Soda Delivery guy.
items.notes: Tied to the Soda Delivery NPC interaction.

items.name: Buzzkill
items.requirement: Kill a player within 10 seconds after they awaken.
items.notes: Requires a fast kill after another player awakens.

items.name: Cheap Trick
items.requirement: Awaken with less than 3 HP.
items.notes: Requires awakening at a very low health threshold.

items.name: Three in One
items.requirement: Impale 3 players with one Playful Cloud throw.
items.notes: Requires lining up three players for one throw.

items.name: if jjs had a public service announcement
items.requirement: Hit 2 players with a train.
items.notes: The source trivia says train-related achievement progress can include hitting yourself with the train.
items.verificationNote: Source Achievement List > General plus trivia note.

items.name: Committed to the Peace
items.requirement: Do a duo emote for 5 minutes without being hit.
items.notes: Requires staying uninterrupted for a long duo emote duration.

items.name: Betavision
items.requirement: Kill a player with Invert and Gravity turned on.
items.notes: Depends on specific settings being enabled.

items.name: Sealed
items.requirement: Force a player to leave during combat.
items.notes: A strange combat-state achievement rather than a normal kill target.

items.name: Space Shenanigans
items.requirement: Get launched into space.
items.notes: A physics or launch-state achievement.

items.name: Yo, it's been a while!
items.requirement: Survive a combo with less than 3 HP.
items.notes: A very low-health survival task.

items.name: Imaginary Technique, Purple
items.requirement: Kill a player with Hollow Purple while high in the air.
items.notes: Requires both the Hollow Purple kill and air position.

items.name: Infinity
items.requirement: Kill a player with full health.
items.notes: Requires maintaining full health through the kill.

items.name: Nine Ropes, Polarized Light
items.requirement: Kill an Awakened Vessel and Mahoraga with Unlimited Purple.
items.notes: Requires specific enemy states and Unlimited Purple.

items.name: Distracted
items.requirement: Get killed by a World Cutting Slash with more than 70 HP.
items.notes: Requires dying to World Cutting Slash while above the listed HP threshold.

items.name: Don't Move!
items.requirement: Kill a player affected by cursed speech with Hollow Purple.
items.notes: The current Achievements source marks this row as currently broken/unobtainable.
items.verificationNote: Source Achievement List > Honored One includes broken/unobtainable note.

items.name: Red hasn't exploded yet...
items.requirement: Miss Reversal Red MAX, but kill with the Black Flash.
items.notes: Requires a missed Reversal Red MAX followed by a Black Flash kill.

items.name: Record Breaker
items.requirement: Land a chain of 4 Black Flashes.
items.notes: Requires chaining four Black Flashes.

items.name: Final Boogie Woogie
items.requirement: After a swap, kill a Perfection with a Black Flash.
items.notes: Requires both a swap setup and a Black Flash kill on Perfection.

items.name: Black Box, Open.
items.requirement: Kill a Mahoraga that has adapted to domains with Open.
items.notes: The source name uses a black square symbol before ', Open.'; the slug uses a readable name.

items.name: Admiring You
items.requirement: Obtain a jackpot on your first roll.
items.notes: Requires hitting Jackpot immediately.

items.name: Overwhelmingly Lucky!
items.requirement: Obtain a jackpot under 25 HP on the first try.
items.notes: Combines first-try Jackpot with a low-health condition.

items.name: On a Roll!
items.requirement: Obtain a jackpot with one roll 3 times in a row in the same life.
items.notes: Requires three one-roll Jackpots before dying.

items.name: Oh, what the hell!
items.requirement: Invade a domain with less than 25 HP.
items.notes: Requires a domain invasion while low on HP.

items.name: I'll Be Dying First
items.requirement: Perform the ritual with less than 10 HP.
items.notes: Requires starting the ritual at a very low HP threshold.

items.name: Adaptation
items.requirement: Fully adapt to one damage type.
items.notes: Uses Mahoraga's adaptation mechanic.

items.name: Lovely.
items.requirement: Adapt to Infinite Void.
items.notes: Requires Mahoraga adaptation against Infinite Void.

items.name: Ready to Go
items.requirement: Help 4 players leave a domain.
items.notes: Uses Ten Shadows domain escape utility.

items.name: What a fool!
items.requirement: Use the Enchain binding vow in a duel.
items.notes: Requires using Enchain in a duel context.

items.name: Huh?
items.requirement: Get killed in your own domain.
items.notes: A Perfection domain-related death achievement.

items.name: What fresh inspiration!
items.requirement: Open your domain with less than 25 HP and kill everyone caught.
items.notes: Requires low HP, a domain open, and all caught players killed.

items.name: Happy Birthday
items.requirement: Switch to your second awakening with less than 15 HP.
items.notes: Requires second awakening at a low HP threshold.

items.name: Apologize in the afterlife
items.requirement: Kill an enemy with Supernova's counter.
items.notes: Requires the Supernova counter to secure the kill.

items.name: Boogie Woogie!
items.requirement: Swap right before getting hit 10 times.
items.notes: Requires repeated last-moment swaps.

items.name: 120% Potential
items.requirement: Kill a player with Black Flash.
items.notes: A Switcher Black Flash kill task.

items.name: Acclamation of the Soul!
items.requirement: Bait a player into attacking an object by feinting.
items.notes: Requires a successful feint bait into an object attack.

items.name: The sound of the Gion Shoja bells...
items.requirement: Swap with a player that's stunned.
items.notes: Requires the target to be stunned when swapped.

items.name: Vegetable
items.requirement: Have all your skills confiscated.
items.notes: A confiscation-state achievement.

items.name: Truly Innocent
items.requirement: Confess 5 times without gaining any sentence.
items.notes: The source trivia says this is awarded to every player but the domain caster on the fifth confession without a guilty verdict.
items.verificationNote: Source Achievement List > Defense Attorney plus trivia note.

items.name: This is my..?!
items.requirement: Hit an awakened Vessel or Strongest Of History with Cleave.
items.notes: Requires Cleave against one of the listed awakened targets.

items.name: Full Catalog
items.requirement: Copy 8 Cursed Techniques in one life.
items.notes: Requires eight copied techniques before dying.

items.name: The one who stands with them...
items.requirement: Hit a player in the air with Projection Sorcery.
items.notes: Requires Projection Sorcery to hit an airborne player.
items.verificationNote: Source Achievement List > Head of the Hei.

items.name: Flowing Red Scale, Huh?
items.requirement: Inflict hemorrhage on a Blood Manipulator.
items.modeOrCharacter: Head of the Hei / Blood Manipulator
items.notes: Requires a hemorrhage effect on a specific character matchup.
items.verificationNote: Source Achievement List > Head of the Hei.

items.name: Damn, gutter trash!
items.requirement: Somehow die while awakening.
items.notes: A death-state achievement tied to awakening.
items.verificationNote: Source Achievement List > Head of the Hei.

items.name: I'll leave the rest to you
items.requirement: Die to Idle Transfiguration.
items.notes: Requires dying to Perfection's Idle Transfiguration.

items.name: Sashimi
items.requirement: Have two limbs staggered at the same time.
items.notes: Requires two simultaneous limb staggers.

items.name: Moderate Effort
items.requirement: Finish a blocking opponent using held Blunt Cut with Ratio.
items.notes: Requires a held Blunt Cut with Ratio against a blocking opponent.

items.name: Accumulation of Little Despairs
items.requirement: Stun a dashing opponent using Reverse Kick.
items.notes: Requires catching a dash with Reverse Kick.

items.name: Keen Eye
items.requirement: Simultaneously land a skill and Ratio Point.
items.notes: Requires Ratio Point and a skill to land at the same time.

items.name: I have no regrets
items.requirement: Survive Self Embodiment of Perfection.
items.notes: Requires surviving Perfection's domain.

items.name: Malaysia
items.requirement: Kill 10 Transfigured Human in one life.
items.notes: Requires multiple Transfigured Human kills without dying.

items.name: Record Holder
items.requirement: Land all stages of Ratio Breaker in under 10 seconds.
items.notes: Requires the full Ratio Breaker sequence inside a short window.

items.name: Overhours
items.requirement: Enter Overtime while having the Overtime binding vow active.
items.notes: Requires Overtime with the matching binding vow active.

items.name: Strength of a Grade 1
items.requirement: Kill a Lucky Coward with Interrogate.
items.notes: Requires Interrogate to kill a specific character.

items.name: Two stones with one bird
items.requirement: Kill 2 players with Bird Strike.
items.notes: Only current Crow Charmer achievement row.

items.name: Can you stand up?
items.requirement: Taunt an opponent under Jawbreaker's effect.
items.notes: Only current Lucky Coward achievement row.

items.name: the curse everyone invited
items.requirement: Break an active domain clash with your invasion.
items.notes: Requires Black Death invasion to break an active domain clash.

items.name: You are the emperor
items.requirement: Reach the soft max limit for parthenogenesis.
items.notes: Requires pushing Black Death's parthenogenesis mechanic to its soft max.

items.name: I love the taste of iron!
items.requirement: Eat 10 players in one life.
items.notes: The current Achievements source marks this row as currently broken/unobtainable.
items.verificationNote: Source Achievement List > Black Death includes broken/unobtainable note.

items.name: I love the taste of IRON!!!!
items.requirement: Eat something that isn't a player.
items.notes: Separate row from the broken player-eating achievement.
